findings.bug: The test credited with import-order determinism rewrites the one-element imports array to the same title import. It tests relocation/key serialization, but never changes import order; MOD-03 and the Phase 7 gate explicitly require this permutation.
findings.predicted: An import-order-dependent resolver can pass this test and the current paired fixture checks.
findings.fix_hint: Use a valid graph with at least two imports and cross-module animation references, reverse imports and manifest module order, and assert identical normalized data/script bytes.

findings.bug: The sole source-aware diagnostic test asserts only the source filename. Its invalid object is at index zero in both its module and the assembled declaration, and it never checks Code or Pointer; no project test asserts original pointers after sorting/reindexing.
findings.predicted: A regression returning an assembled index or dropping the original pointer will stay green while agents are directed to the wrong field in an owned module.
findings.fix_hint: Add nested object and animation failures whose original indexes differ from assembled indexes, asserting exact code, relative source file and original source pointer in the resolver and CLI JSON result.

findings.bug: Blender interpolation probes cover isolated location tracks and a rotation endpoint; none combines different interpolation modes on one object or samples animated material sockets. These exercise different action owners and curve-selection paths in apply_animation, so single-property probes do not cover the supported animation contract.
findings.predicted: Interpolation can leak between transform properties or remain at Blender defaults for material curves without failing current regression tests.
findings.fix_hint: Add a reopened Blender probe with step location plus linear rotation on one object and step/linear material tracks; assert interior samples independently and repeat with track order reversed.

findings.bug: The concurrent shot integration still runs only three successful previews and checks artifact existence/distinct job directories. Separate timeout/failure tests do not exercise the required concurrent successful/failed-shot matrix or assert manifest shot attribution. The repair verification correctly acknowledges this remaining gap.
findings.predicted: Failure attribution or sibling-output contamination during concurrent shot jobs can regress while all current concurrency and standalone-failure tests pass.
findings.fix_hint: Run concurrent jobs with one deliberately failing shot and assert each successful manifest/dependency manifest has its expected shot ID, while only the failed job has a failed marker and no complete manifest.

findings.bug: SCENE-02 still credits easing at intermediate frames, but there is no dedicated Blender interior-sample assertion for ease_in_out. Existing step/linear samples and rotation endpoint checks cannot distinguish an eased curve from linear interpolation. The repair verification leaves this probe open.
findings.predicted: An incorrect easing mapping can pass the suite despite the recorded SCENE-02 acceptance claim.
findings.fix_hint: Add a pinned-Blender easing fixture and probe asymmetric interior frames against the documented easing tolerance, in addition to its endpoints.
